create_profiler_schedule: create an xformers _Profiler with an output directory, schedule of profiler start/end steps, and an optional nn.Module
run_pytorch_profiler: run PyTorchProfiler to capture CPU and CUDA traces, memory footprint, and flop analysis via TensorBoard
run_nsight_profiler: run NsightProfiler to trigger the NVIDIA Nsight profiler via context manager with cudaProfilerApi capture range
capture_memory_snapshots: capture CUDA memory allocation and deallocation traces with MemSnapshotsProfiler and export an HTML trace plot
summarize_profiler_summary: summarize the xformers profiler summary with step time, TFlops, HFU, and MFU metrics after profiling completes
